organization.name_ja: 株式会社カインドオル

affected.note: Customers of the online store of Kindal, a used designer clothing subsidiary of Treasure Factory; 109,311 of them had addresses included. Credit card data and login passwords were not included. Follow-up investigation confirmed the exported file was downloaded by the attacker.

summary.en: Kindal, a subsidiary of Treasure Factory, said a third party took over a staff account on the e-commerce platform behind its online store, using credentials obtained through a phishing email, and bulk-exported customer data twice on 2026-08-23. Personal data of 136,464 customers, such as names, addresses, phone numbers and email addresses, leaked.
summary.ja: トレジャー・ファクトリーの子会社カインドオルは、ECサイトで利用するプラットフォームのスタッフアカウントがフィッシングメールで取得された認証情報により乗っ取られ、2026年8月23日に顧客情報が2回一括エクスポートされたと発表した。氏名、住所、電話番号、メールアドレスなど136,464人分の個人情報が漏えいした。
